title: Shotgun Reload
blurb: Three metallic clacks inside a single second: two close together, a short pause, then the one that closes the action. Almost nothing here sits below 200 Hz. The whole recording lives around a kilohertz, the register an ear reads as mechanism rather than force, and that keeps it out of the way of everything else in a mix. It was captured quietly, so expect to add gain. Editors use pump foley much as they use a door latch or a seatbelt click, a small sound whose job is telling the audience that a scene has just changed gear.
origin: A generic pump-action shotgun foley recording, widely used in video editing.
